purpose: Teach: 寸法/鉢/悩ま/こぼし/とかし/しり/ふる/低かっ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、制服の寸法、合ってる?ちょっと長くない?
lines.en: Riku, does your uniform fit right? Isn't it a bit long?
lines.style: Casual, observational opener. Genuine question—she's noticed something small about him. Light, teasing undertone. No judgment, just fact-checking. Leans slightly forward with interest.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。文化部、植木鉢、教室に置いてるよな。
lines.en: Yeah. The culture club's got flowerpots in the classroom, you know?
lines.style: Deflecting with a non-sequitur, but there's a smile underneath. Quick rhythm—he's changing the subject on purpose but not unkindly. The kind of thing you say when you're trying not to be seen.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 最近、進路のこと、悩まされるの、私。
lines.en: Career stuff's been weighing on me lately, honestly.
lines.style: Lowered tone, slightly vulnerable. She's testing whether he'll actually engage. Steady pace, no rush to fill silence. Sincere underneath the casualness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: カフェで、ジュース、こぼしちゃってさ、お前、笑ってたな。
lines.en: You spilled juice at the café the other day and you just laughed about it.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost gentle. He's bringing up a moment—a real memory of her being herself. Small smile in the voice. He's saying something without saying it directly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昨日、髪、入念にとかして、自信、ついた。
lines.en: Yesterday I took time with my hair and actually felt better about myself.
lines.style: Lighter note, a small brightness breaking through. She's opening up a little—letting him see the smaller confidences. Not bragging, just sharing. Warmth in the delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 子供の頃、お前のしりとり、結構強かったよな。
lines.en: You were pretty good at shiritori when we were kids, weren't you?
lines.style: Reaching back to a shared memory. Softens the deflection with something genuine—he's meeting her halfway by acknowledging something real about her past. Understated warmth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 雨がふるって予報だから、傘、持ってきたよ。
lines.en: The forecast said rain, so I brought an umbrella.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, practical. No fanfare. She's being responsible in a quiet way—maybe also thinking about whether he remembered to bring one. Small care underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 去年のテストの点、結構、低かったわ、俺。
lines.en: My test scores last year were pretty rough, to be honest.
lines.style: Self-deprecating admission, low and almost confessional. He's meeting her vulnerability with his own. Not fishing for reassurance—just putting it on the table. Tired but honest.
